messages:
maria: Starting RBAC schema migration v3 now. Running the default_role backfill. Noticing some failures, pausing rollout to investigate.

maria: migration command: `rails db:migrate:up VERSION=20250401123456`

oncall: acknowledged, pausing. I'll collect logs and block further deploys to the migration job. @maria share error output when you have it. :eyes: 

devon: can you paste the error lines from the migration job? stacktrace or SQL error would help.

maria: pasting error snippet:
```
ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid (PG::NotNullViolation: ERROR:  null value in column "account_id" violates not-null constraint
DETAIL:  Failing row contains (uuid, role, NULL, created_at, updated_at).)
/var/app/releases/…/db/migrate/20250401_backfill_default_roles.rb:42:in `block in up'
```

ajohnson: looks like the backfill assumed account_id present for all role rows. We have some legacy service accounts that were created without account linkage. The script didn't coalesce defaults.

devon: also seeing a couple hundred role rows with role IS NULL and user_id pointing to `users` rows where email IS NULL. Probably service bots. We should avoid failing the whole migration for these.

maria: hypothesis: migration tried to set default_role based on users.email domain and failed when account_id was missing. I'll run a quick query to confirm counts.

maria: query run: `SELECT count(*) FROM roles WHERE account_id IS NULL;` -> 438 rows.

ajohnson: Proposed safe backfill patch: coalesce missing account_id to a special system-account and set role = 'service' for those entries. Example update: 
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE roles r
SET account_id = coalesce(r.account_id, (SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE name='system' LIMIT 1)),
    role = coalesce(r.role, 'service')
WHERE r.account_id IS NULL OR r.role IS NULL
  AND r.id BETWEEN $start AND $end;
COMMIT;
```

ajohnson: We'll run that in 10k-id windows to avoid long locks.

oncall: run in chunks, and please include `WHERE role IS DISTINCT FROM coalesce(role, 'service')` to minimize writes. Also add a safety TTL to skip rows modified in last 5m.

maria: plan update: rollback migration (so schema stays at pre-v3), apply chunked backfill patch, re-run migration once counts are zero. Target re-run tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need approvals from security and infra.

sasha: +1 from security, but also open a monitoring alert for audit-logs spike and KMS calls during re-run.

sec-bot: Created ticket SE-4387: "rbac backfill: account_id nulls causing migration failure" and attached logs.

devon: small note: when re-running, use `pg_try_advisory_lock` around backfill batches to avoid overlap with other jobs. Also set statement_timeout for each chunk.

maria: good catch. I'll include advisory locks and LIMIT-based batching. Running rollback now.

deploy-bot: rollback job started for migration 20250401_backfill_default_roles.rb by maria at 2025-04-01T16:40:30Z.

maria: rollback completed, schema reverted, no downtime observed. Current roles with null account_id: 438 -> planning to backfill in 10k ranges now.

maria: after backfill run (chunk 1/1): updated 438 rows, no constraint violations. Verified counts: `SELECT count(*) FROM roles WHERE account_id IS NULL;` -> 0.

maria: scheduling migration re-run for 2025-04-02 09:00 PT, putting a canary of 1k requests and monitoring audit log ingestion and KMS metrics. I'll post the runbook with commands and rollback steps in #eng-oncall.

devon: thanks. recommend a post-run quick audit: sample 50 random role rows to confirm role semantics.

maria: will do. thanks all. :raised_hands:
